scope_note: PRICE was trained on all 26 of these databases and we trained on 23; a win here measures fit, not resistance to spatial drift. Drift evidence lives only on the four target databases.
needs_evidence_reason: the ours_k0 side is one seed (42); seed coverage is not part of this sweep
metric: unique-query population Q95 (single pass, NOT episode mean)

price.maxima_rule: explicit --maxima override (passed on the command line; see doc 101 §3: maxima is a PRICE layout parameter, so numbers computed under different maxima must not be quoted together)

distribution.pairwise_note: ours_better_than_pg and ours_better_than_price are independent pairwise counts (our Q95 strictly below that baseline); they do not sum to n_databases and are not the same as tier_counts

bucket_4plus_empty.reason: every query in these databases has fewer than four tables, so the 4+ bucket is empty and its Q95 is undefined (null); they are excluded from the 4+ ratio distribution only

distribution.ratio_convention: ratio > 1 means we have the lower (better) Q error; ratio < 1 means the baseline is better than us
distribution.tier_rule: beats_pg_and_price: our Q95 strictly below both; beats_pg_loses_price: strictly below PG but not below PRICE; loses_pg: greater than or equal to PG (ties count as losses)
